title: Treatise on Lunge and Riposte
summary: Joins the parry to the answering thrust so a student of the early qi stages strikes in the foe's own beat.

title: The Disengaging Point Course
summary: Trains the point to slip under the foe's blade and rise on the other side with a little qi behind it.

title: Drill-Book of Beat and Bind
summary: A drill-book of beating the foe's blade aside and binding it so the point finds the opened line.

title: A Canon of the Circle Parry
summary: Shows how circling the point around the foe's steel carries his thrust off line and leaves him open.

title: Handbook of Feint and Counter-Thrust
summary: Teaches false attacks that draw a parry and the true thrust that follows it for students of the Warrior stages.

title: Passing Step Workbook
summary: A workbook of the long crossing steps that close or break distance while the point stays on its line.

title: The Measure and Tempo Treatise
summary: A treatise on the gap between two duelists and the beat in which it may be stolen.

title: Compendium of Low Line Thrusts
summary: Collects the thrusts that go beneath the guard to the hip and knee and the rises that follow them.

title: Reading of the Stop-Thrust
summary: Instructs the student to meet an advancing foe with a thrust that halts him before his own lands.
